facts.text: Iego was a mysterious planet located in the Outer Rim Territories on the fringes of the known galaxy that was surrounded by a thousand moons collectively known as the moons of Iego, at least one of which was populated by a race of beings known as Angels.

evidence.quote: Iego was a mysterious planet located in the Outer Rim Territories on the fringes of the known galaxy that was surrounded by a thousand moons collectively known as the moons of Iego, at least one of which was populated by a race of beings known as Angels.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems constructed a laser field that prevented anyone from leaving the planet, before the field was destroyed by Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, freeing the Iegoans.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems constructed a laser field that prevented anyone from leaving the planet, before the field was destroyed by Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, freeing the Iegoans.

facts.text: Located on the fringes of the known galaxy, the planet Iego was orbited by a thousand moons collectively known as the moons of Iego, including Clepresdan, Cobarb, Flitrude, Millius Prime, Rawnde, Uncovalor, and Winlion.

evidence.quote: Located on the fringes of the known galaxy, the planet Iego was orbited by a thousand moons collectively known as the moons of Iego, including Clepresdan, Cobarb, Flitrude, Millius Prime, Rawnde, Uncovalor, and Winlion.

facts.text: Iego, named the Planet of a Thousand Moons, was a planet located in the Extrictarium Nebula in the Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: Iego, named the Planet of a Thousand Moons, was a planet located in the Extrictarium Nebula in the Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: Iego did not orbit a sun; rather, it was warmed by local stellar gases.

evidence.quote: Iego did not orbit a sun; rather, it was warmed by local stellar gases.

facts.text: It was home to the subterranean Maelibi species, as well as thousands of stranded spacefarers who had been lured to the planet by the Diathim—a spaceworthy species that resided on Iego's forty-two moons.

evidence.quote: It was home to the subterranean Maelibi species, as well as thousands of stranded spacefarers who had been lured to the planet by the Diathim—a spaceworthy species that resided on Iego's forty-two moons.

facts.text: Iego's original inhabitants, the Maelibi (also called Demons), were large, subterranean creatures that sang a song so pure that it was regarded as the very essence of song.

evidence.quote: Iego's original inhabitants, the Maelibi (also called Demons), were large, subterranean creatures that sang a song so pure that it was regarded as the very essence of song.

facts.text: They lived in large, underground caverns, but they intermittently poached the castaway population, dragging their screaming victims back below ground.

evidence.quote: They lived in large, underground caverns, but they intermittently poached the castaway population, dragging their screaming victims back below ground.

facts.text: The inhabitants of Iego's moon Millius Prime, Diathim (also called Angels), were vibrant, flying creatures that were said to be of legendary beauty.

evidence.quote: The inhabitants of Iego's moon Millius Prime, Diathim (also called Angels), were vibrant, flying creatures that were said to be of legendary beauty.

facts.text: When a new starship arrived in orbit, a mass of angels assembled around it, entrancing the pilot into crashing his ship onto the rocky surface of Iego.

evidence.quote: When a new starship arrived in orbit, a mass of angels assembled around it, entrancing the pilot into crashing his ship onto the rocky surface of Iego.

facts.text: A mass of starships named The Scatter sat on Iego's surface and around it lived the castaway tribes.

evidence.quote: A mass of starships named The Scatter sat on Iego's surface and around it lived the castaway tribes.

facts.text: A former state of Xim's Empire, towards the end of the Old Republic, spice convoys visited the planet and brought more civilized living to the inhabitants.

evidence.quote: A former state of Xim's Empire, towards the end of the Old Republic, spice convoys visited the planet and brought more civilized living to the inhabitants.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the Separatists invaded the planet and established battle droid garrisons, intending to use Iego as a redoubt should their war go against them.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the Separatists invaded the planet and established battle droid garrisons, intending to use Iego as a redoubt should their war go against them.

facts.text: The inhabitants of the planet believed the amount of casualties in orbit was because of the wrath of "Drol," a destructive spirit that would allow nobody to leave the planet.

evidence.quote: The inhabitants of the planet believed the amount of casualties in orbit was because of the wrath of "Drol," a destructive spirit that would allow nobody to leave the planet.

facts.text: Jaybo Hood, a ten year old prodigy, made use of the battle droids left on the planet and reassigned them to his personal commands.

evidence.quote: Jaybo Hood, a ten year old prodigy, made use of the battle droids left on the planet and reassigned them to his personal commands.

facts.text: When Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived on the planet to collect a reeksa root necessary to create an antidote to the Blue Shadow Virus, the locals told them about the myth of Drol.

evidence.quote: When Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived on the planet to collect a reeksa root necessary to create an antidote to the Blue Shadow Virus, the locals told them about the myth of Drol.

facts.text: During the Second Imperial Civil War, Iego was one of the worlds that supported the Galactic Alliance Remnant.

evidence.quote: During the Second Imperial Civil War, Iego was one of the worlds that supported the Galactic Alliance Remnant.

facts.text: The Scatter was located in the far south of the planet and almost every being who was unfortunate enough to be stranded stayed there for the rest of their lives.

evidence.quote: The Scatter was located in the far south of the planet and almost every being who was unfortunate enough to be stranded stayed there for the rest of their lives.

facts.text: The Choir Alignment was located near the planet's equator and was one of the few places that the Diathim would touch down on the planet's surface.

evidence.quote: The Choir Alignment was located near the planet's equator and was one of the few places that the Diathim would touch down on the planet's surface.

facts.text: The Boneyard was in the north, bordering Iego's mountains.

evidence.quote: The Boneyard was in the north, bordering Iego's mountains.

facts.text: It consisted of massive bones, too big to be from any known creature.

evidence.quote: It consisted of massive bones, too big to be from any known creature.

facts.text: Iego was first mentioned in The Phantom Menace by the character Anakin Skywalker.
entities: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

evidence.quote: Iego was first mentioned in The Phantom Menace by the character Anakin Skywalker.

facts.text: In the novel Labyrinth of Evil, Iego is misspelled as "Viago." The correct spelling of "Iego" was confirmed by Leland Chee in a thread at the StarWars.com message boards.

evidence.quote: In the novel Labyrinth of Evil, Iego is misspelled as "Viago." The correct spelling of "Iego" was confirmed by Leland Chee in a thread at the StarWars.com message boards.

facts.text: Cliffhold was a spaceport city that was built directly into the face of a basalt cliff on the planet Iego. By the time of the Clone Wars, Cliffhold was much less busy than in previous times due to the spice convoys no longer running through the area.

evidence.quote: Cliffhold was a spaceport city that was built directly into the face of a basalt cliff on the planet Iego. By the time of the Clone Wars, Cliffhold was much less busy than in previous times due to the spice convoys no longer running through the area.

facts.text: Cliffhold was a spaceport city that was built directly into the face of a cliff on the Outer Rim Territories world of Iego. Founded in the later years of the Galactic Republic, Cliffhold was used by smugglers as a center for spice production.

facts.text: The Boneyard was the largest of the many piles of bones on Iego. Lying north of The Scatter, the Boneyard held gigantic skeletons of unknown creatures.

evidence.quote: The Boneyard was the largest of the many piles of bones on Iego. Lying north of The Scatter, the Boneyard held gigantic skeletons of unknown creatures.

facts.text: The Choir Alignment was a valley on the planet Iego between The Scatter and The Boneyard. 100 meters across and shaped like a nine-pointed star, it was clearly artificial in nature. It was said that when one stood in the center, the moons of Iego were arranged in geometric patterns.

evidence.quote: The Choir Alignment was a valley on the planet Iego between The Scatter and The Boneyard. 100 meters across and shaped like a nine-pointed star, it was clearly artificial in nature. It was said that when one stood in the center, the moons of Iego were arranged in geometric patterns.

facts.text: Rawk's Nest was a series of buildings on Iego inhabited by "Bantha" Rawk and his family. In 137 ABY the Nest came under attack by Black Sun, trying to force "Bantha" Rawk to pay protection money.

evidence.quote: Rawk's Nest was a series of buildings on Iego inhabited by "Bantha" Rawk and his family. In 137 ABY the Nest came under attack by Black Sun, trying to force "Bantha" Rawk to pay protection money.

facts.text: The Scatter was a shallow valley on Iego where Angels crashed all starships. It was filled with the wreckage of spacecrafts, and even some workable parts.

evidence.quote: The Scatter was a shallow valley on Iego where Angels crashed all starships. It was filled with the wreckage of spacecrafts, and even some workable parts.

facts.text: The Skirmish on Iego was a confrontation between members of Black Sun and "Bantha" Rawk's family which happened a short time after Cade Skywalker's escape from the Sith.

evidence.quote: The Skirmish on Iego was a confrontation between members of Black Sun and "Bantha" Rawk's family which happened a short time after Cade Skywalker's escape from the Sith.
